paragraphs: PepsiCo, Inc. is an American multinational food and beverage corporation headquartered in Harrison, New York, in the hamlet of Purchase. PepsiCo's business encompasses all aspects of the food and beverage market. It oversees the manufacturing, distribution, and marketing of its products. PepsiCo was formed in 1965 with the merger of the Pepsi-Cola Company and Frito-Lay, Inc., PepsiCo has since expanded from its namesake product Pepsi to a diversified range of food and beverage brands. Significant acquisitions include Tropicana Products in 1998, the Quaker Oats Company in 2001, which added the Gatorade brand to the Pepsi portfolio, and Pioneer Foods in 2020 for US$1.7 billion.

As of January 2021, the company possesses 23 brands that each have over $1 billion in sales annually. PepsiCo products were distributed across more than 200 countries and territories, resulting in annual net revenues of over US$70 billion. PepsiCo is the second-largest food and beverage business in the world based on net revenue, profit, and market capitalization, behind Nestlé. In 2023, the company's seat in the Forbes Global 2000 was 82.  PepsiCo's flagship product, Pepsi Cola, has been engaged in a rivalry for generations with Coca-Cola; it is commonly referred to as the cola wars. Although Coca-Cola outsells Pepsi Cola in the United States, PepsiCo within the North American market is the largest food and beverage company by net revenue. The company's beverage distribution and bottling is conducted by PepsiCo as well as by licensed bottlers in certain regions.

PepsiCo has received criticism over poor working conditions, contributing to deforestation, use of genetically modified ingredients, significant water usage, presence of pesticide residue in products, contributing to global plastic pollution, significant carbon dioxide emissions, and poor product nutrition. In 2024, PepsiCo was the second-highest producer of branded plastic pollution globally.

people.name: David J. Flavell
people.title: Executive Vice President, General Counsel and Corporate Secretary, PepsiCo
people.bio: Flavell has held his current role since 2021 after serving in several PepsiCo legal leadership positions. Before joining PepsiCo in 2011, he was general counsel for Danone's Asia Pacific and Middle East business.
people.quote: David J. Flavell has served as Executive Vice President, General Counsel and Corporate Secretary, PepsiCo since 2021.

people.name: Athina Kanioura
people.title: Chief Executive Officer, PepsiCo Latin America Foods and Executive Vice President, Strategy & Transformation Officer
people.bio: Kanioura was appointed to her current role in December 2025 after serving as PepsiCo's Executive Vice President and Chief Strategy and Transformation Officer from 2020. Previously, she held analytics and applied intelligence leadership roles at Accenture.
people.quote: Athina Kanioura was appointed Chief Executive Officer, PepsiCo Latin America Foods and Executive Vice President, Strategy & Transformation Officer in December 2025.

people.name: Ram Krishnan
people.title: Chief Executive Officer, PepsiCo North America
people.bio: Krishnan was appointed Chief Executive Officer, PepsiCo North America, effective December 2025, after leading U.S. Beverages. He joined PepsiCo in 2006 and has held marketing, commercial and regional leadership roles.
people.quote: Ram Krishnan was appointed Chief Executive Officer, PepsiCo North America, effective December 2025.

people.name: Ramon L. Laguarta
people.title: Chairman of the Board of Directors and Chief Executive Officer, PepsiCo
people.bio: Laguarta has served as PepsiCo's Chief Executive Officer and a director since 2018 and became Chairman in 2019. He joined PepsiCo in 1996 and previously served as President and in European leadership roles.
people.quote: Ramon L. Laguarta has served as PepsiCo's Chief Executive Officer and a director on the Board since 2018

people.name: Silviu Popovici
people.title: Chief Executive Officer, Europe, Middle East and Africa
people.bio: Popovici was appointed to his current role effective January 2025 after serving as Chief Executive Officer, Europe from 2019 to 2024. He joined PepsiCo in 2011 following its acquisition of Wimm-Bill-Dann Foods.
people.quote: Silviu Popovici was appointed Chief Executive Officer, Europe, Middle East and Africa, effective January 2025.

people.name: Becky Schmitt
people.title: Executive Vice President and Chief People Officer, PepsiCo
people.bio: Schmitt has served in her current role since June 2023. Previously, she was Executive Vice President, Chief People Officer at Cognizant and held human resources leadership roles at Walmart and Accenture.
people.quote: Becky Schmitt has served as Executive Vice President and Chief People Officer, PepsiCo, since June 2023.

people.name: Stephen T. Schmitt
people.title: Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, PepsiCo
people.bio: Schmitt joined PepsiCo on November 10, 2025, succeeding Jamie Caulfield as Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer. Previously, he served as Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer for Walmart U.S. and held roles at Yum! Brands.
